meta.name: autonomous-investigation
meta.description: The protocol behind every investigation skill. Use when AI research must proceed without you: search-plan gate, Fact/Inference/Assumption labels, confidence stacking, diffable outputs.

copy.tagline: 让AI研究自动进行，无需人工介入
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要AI自主完成多步骤调研并输出结构化结果
copy.tagline_en: Let AI research proceed without manual intervention
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need AI to autonomously conduct multi-step research and output structured results

howto.what: 让Claude按一套固定协议做无人值守的网络调研：只追问有限几个问题，先给你看搜索计划；每条关键结论标成“事实/推断/假设”，查不到的列入缺口，再用固定版式输出，方便和上次对比。
howto.when: 当你要AI自己把一项调研跑完（例如每季度重跑竞品扫描、定时生成市场情报），或要求结论能区分事实与猜测并逐次可比时，这套规范会接管。

say.text: 请就某公司进入流程自动化做一次自主调查，支撑我们下季度决策。
say.note: 会先给三点搜索计划，等你确认后再开跑。

say.text: 把这个竞品扫描设成每季度自动重跑，输出结构保持稳定，便于对比。
say.note: 无人回答也会带假设继续跑，不会卡住。

say.text: 调研最近行业采购预算动向，结论标成“事实/推断/假设”，查不到的列入缺口。
say.note: 每条关键结论会附上可核验的链接。

howto.what_en: Claude runs unattended research under a fixed protocol: asks few clarifying questions, shows a search plan first, labels each claim Fact/Inference/Assumption, records unknowns in a gaps list, and emits a stable schema for cross-run comparison.
howto.when_en: Triggers when research should run without you: scheduled competitive scans, automatic market snapshots, or any task needing evidence labels and diffable output.

say_en.text: Investigate Acme's move into workflow automation autonomously; supports Q3 bet
say_en.note: Shows a 3-point search plan and waits for your approval.

say_en.text: Rerun this competitor scan quarterly; keep output stable for diffing
say_en.note: Runs unattended; proceeds on assumptions if no answers.

say_en.text: Review recent procurement budget shifts; tag claims Fact/Inference/Assumption
say_en.note: Key claims get cited sources; unknowns go into gaps.
